text:
micah_support: Heads-up — Orbitly (trial, acct 9876) hitting intermittent embed-ingest failures over last 24h. Multiple 502s/timeouts, and recommendations are degrading. Ticket #12345. Tried requeue + worker restart, still flapping. Logs excerpt: ```ERROR embed_worker timeout 504 after 30s | kv-cache miss spike | batch process abort``` Renewal flagged (60d). Need CS to take point on comms + prioritized onboarding runbook ASAP.

ashley_cs: Acknowledged. Assigning for triage — @diego_se can you take a look? We need a comms plan and a customer call today EOD if possible.

diego_se: Looking into logs now. Initial hypothesis: backpressure from KV cache evictions combined with sudden batch-size spikes from their SDK. Quick mitigation: reduce batch_size to 8 and enable tenant prefix caching. I'll validate in staging.

micah_support: Deployed reduced batch_size=8 to a canary at 12:30, monitoring. Customer sent: "we're getting wrong embeddings, bad recs" — they want a scheduled call. Can CS lead 3pm PST?

ashley_cs: 3pm PST works for me. @emma_onboard_pm can you join for runbook + checklist? Comms plan: 1) own + apologize 2) explain mitigation 3) immediate ask (1hr reingest window) 4) follow-up cadence (every 2h). I'll send invite and a short email draft.

emma_onboard_pm: On it. Checklist items: confirm data freshness, identify sample UUIDs for failing vectors, confirm no duplicate sends from client, reingest window + rollback plan. Micah — can you paste a few failing UUIDs here?

micah_support: Samples attached in ticket #12345: uuid: b4f3... , f9c2... Also noticed token_count spikes during ingest bursts — might be client resending on timeout.

diego_se: Thanks. Ran staging test with batch_size=8 + prefix cache; result: 90% fewer timeouts. Will promote to canary prod in 30m and monitor for similarity drift in embeddings. If stable, full roll in +2h with read-only fallback.

ashley_cs: Drafting a short customer message: "We're sorry — we've identified ingestion backpressure causing timeouts and degraded embeddings. We've deployed a mitigation to reduce batch sizes and will reingest a verified window. We request a 1hr window to run this and will update every 2 hours until fully resolved." I'll DM the draft and post after approval.

micah_support: Customer accepted 3pm call and the 1hr reingest window. They also asked to speak with a contract rep about renewal risk — looping in @nina_sales.

nina_sales: On standby for 3pm. I can join if the convo shifts to renewal/terms.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for tenant:orbitly at 1743126790 — canary id c-1729 ✅

diego_se: Canary metrics look promising: ~95% reduction in 502s in first 10m. Watching embedding similarity histograms for drift; no sign yet.

ashley_cs: Good. Plan for the call: 1) quick root-cause summary 2) what we did (canary + next steps) 3) timelines for full roll + reingest 4) actions for customer (1hr window + sample verification). After the call we'll capture feedback, open a one-off eval to validate embedding quality, and add Orbitly to the renewal-watchboard.

micah_support: I'll update ticket with canary KPIs and post the 3pm invite link. Thanks all.

ashley_cs: Thanks team — I'll lead comms on the call and update the renewal risk playbook after.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary promoted to full rollout for tenant:orbitly at 1743126885 ✅
